answer: Cross-chain identity binding: one verified address per chain, bound by a periodic proof-of-pulse signature relayed across bridges. Each new chain identity costs a fresh bond plus gas on N chains, so k identities cost k*N bonds. A hollow identity cluster shows mismatched pulse timing; the tundra of unlinked chains exposes farms. Attacker pays N times honest cost per sybil, capping farms below profit. Works because binding makes each identity expensive and detectable.
